notes.title: Planet Stronghold version 1.1.2
notes.notes: Just a simple fix, removing the dialogue window stuck in the game during the gameplay part (map, combat, etc).

notes.title: Planet Stronghold 2 - update 1.1.1
notes.notes:
While doing previous update, I forgot to include several image files. The game would work, but you would notice missing artwork! Thanks to user Ailienkiller for letting me know.
Also optimized some animations and removed old code. Briefly tested it and everything seems to work.

Happy New Year!

notes.title: Planet Stronghold version 1.1
notes.notes:
[b]Please note that old saves might not work with this update![/b]

[b]What's New in 1.1[/b]

- updated to latest Ren'Py version (achievements should work again now!)
- fixed a crash bug while upgrading a weapon/armor due to new Python 3 implementation
- fixed a rare crash bug while in colony
- game should now generally run faster

notes.title: Planet Stronghold 2 version 1.0.20
notes.notes:
[h3]What's New in 1.0.20[/h3]

- updated to the newest Ren'Py library version 
- fixed a crash bug while accessing the Gallery screen from main menu

notes.title: Planet Stronghold 2 version 1.0.19
notes.notes:
I've pushed a new update, this time both on the beta (new 32-bit HW accelerated, Python 3.0 version) and the current live version (16-bit backward compatible).
It fixes a crash when clicking on the numbered pages in the save screen, and a bug in chapter 4 where you could end up with only 1 character, but 2 minimum are required for the party. Now you fight 3 consecutive battles and in each of them you can bring maximum 3 characters.

notes.title: Planet Stronghold 2 version 1.0.18
notes.notes:
Hi,
I've rebuild the game using Ren'Py 8 / Python 3. This new version includes several hardware optimizations and fixed a bug on level up (Mind attribute not resetting).
The downside is that it doesn't work anymore on 16-bit versions, so for now I put this new build in a new beta branch that you can access by going into the game properties and choosing "beta" in the beta builds.

Once I'm sure this new version doesn't have any bug, will make it the default and keep the old ones for users who are still on 16-bit systems.

Note that due to the new MacOS restrictions the game might not work anymore in future on Mac.

notes.title: Planet Stronghold 2 version 1.0.16
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32948434/2182f128cb1c649fa4367ff617e28f7aa9d47015.jpg[/img]
What's New in 1.0.16

- fixed the Barrage skill: erroneously was listed as possible with SMG, instead it can be used only if you've a MachineGun or Assault Rifle equipped
- fixed a crash bug in Lakadema good ending if you reached it without any romance
- fixed level text appearing in red in the Engineering screen due to last selecting a lower level character in the character screen
- added a way to free memory just before the credits screen hoping to fix an ultra-rare memory error (in any case is during the ending credits so nothing from the story is missed)
- fixed an "XP bug" during the quest War Crimes, which wouldn't clear the location even after failing the Charisma check, with the result that you could repeat that part endlessly and farm a lot of XP!

notes.title: Planet Stronghold update 1.0.14
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32948434/881d8e650463f24505725d851af735c2cba71fa3.jpg[/img][b]What's New in 1.0.14[/b]

- fixed a bug with Luxinde buff in Philipp's final battle (was duplicating Regen ID causing side effects)

- empire scouts had wrong icon in battle turn order portraits

- the level of item decrypted is based on the level you were when you got datapad, and not when it's decrypted (I've changed the text)

- the chapter 2 side quest "Rebuild A Future" sometimes might fail with bad luck (uncommon but could happen), I have tweaked the values so it should be easier to make it

- to balance the excessive damage of SMG/Machinegun/Assault Rifles I've reduced the Critical value of those 3 weapon types

- the right non-combat skill to reveal enemy information was Psionics, and not Culture (which gives already an Acid damage bonus). This has been fixed now, also in the help texts

- fixed wrong color for Arnox Warchief during chapter 3 quest to kill Apex Alpha

- fixed more typos

notes.title: Planet Stronghold 2 version 1.0.13
notes.notes:
What's New in 1.0.13

- the Charm skill was displaying wrong length values. Now the length matches what's written in the skill description and also in the battle debuff icons
- during the "talking about loss" scene Milo could be erroneously apologizing to Cliff even if he wasn't present (game was picking current romance automatically)
- fixed some more typos

The game OST featuring 24 unique tracks is now available:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/858800/Planet_Stronghold_2__OST/

notes.title: Planet Stronghold 2 version 1.0.11
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32948434/e27177413372ab1cd96a5d5faa9d11f832eae4d1.jpg[/img]
What's New in 1.0.11

- by mistake you could trigger Cliff talk in the armory if playing as Rebel and starting romance with him, this has been fixed
- added explanation of HP/PP Regen depleting in battles in the attribute screen
- if you went in the medbay and used the Gharl Stones to gain XP, it would add Milo/Michelle to the party even if you haven't recruited them yet. I decided to enable this only starting from Day 12 to avoid possible conflicts like this
- by mistake during Lucille scenes two voices could be played at same time
- added an extra line during Michelle Loyal intro showing she has drinking problems now (that was obvious only if you started the game as Rebel)
